text:
Noah Li: Observed intermittent 502s during per-customer endpoint rollout. Pattern: clients hit relay -> relay forwarded to new endpoint; handshake fails for ~20s then recovers.
Sonia Verma: Likely connection-pool reuse at relay holding stale upstream certs. Did we see "certificate expired" or "not yet valid"?
Noah Li: "certificate signature failure" then "handshake timeout" in logs. Reproduce by rotating endpoint cert and sending steady traffic.
Evan Brooks: Two paths: (A) make agents/relyers detect upstream cert change and recreate connections, or (B) keep relay terminating and proxy traffic until endpoint is fully warmed.
Sonia Verma: (A) needs graceful drain hooks and pool age metrics. (B) preserves customer-facing stability but increases relay responsibilities and entangles cert ops.
Noah Li: Proposed short-term: add a relay toggle "proxy-stay" that keeps termination for 3m post-cutover, while we warm endpoint and validate connections. Long-term: implement conn-pool cert watch + server_name validation on reuse.
Evan Brooks: Add telemetry: conn-age histogram, downstream-retries, and cert-change events per-route. Also an operator rollback script to switch all traffic to relay for a cust group.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: rollout started for endpoint-cutover-fix at 2025-10-12T09:02:00Z
Sonia Verma: Agree. I'll write a short RFC follow-up with the toggle, metrics, and rollback steps. Include guidance on DNS TTLs and mobile client caching.
Noah Li: Thanks — will add a staging test that toggles certs and validates no 5xx for a traffic spike.
